jobs.title: HRIS & Payroll Implementation Associate
jobs.summary: Support HRIS setup, payroll process mapping, and client onboarding.
responsibilities: Assist with HRIS configuration, testing, and go-live support.
Document payroll processes and controls with client teams.
Support data cleanup, imports, and basic reporting.
Coordinate training sessions and rollout communications.
requirements: 1–3 years experience in HR, payroll, or HRIS support.
Comfortable with Excel and structured data.

jobs.title: Finance & Compliance Officer
jobs.summary: Own monthly finance operations and statutory compliance follow-ups.
responsibilities: Prepare monthly finance reports and reconciliations.
Coordinate statutory compliance documentation and filings.
Maintain audit-ready records and improve internal controls.
requirements: Diploma/degree in accounting, finance, or related field.
Attention to detail and ability to work to deadlines.
